compile.semantic_transition_policy: support/contact/threat ownership changes only at authored decisive keys

keys.name: OFFSET_READY
keys.causal_role: establish a crooked ready silhouette with the roof-side shoulder already higher
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis left of stance center; guard side is high but not yet closed

keys.name: ROOF_PRELOAD
keys.causal_role: close an asymmetric overhead roof before contact while sinking COM
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis sinks left; right hand establishes the future contact point before impact

keys.name: PRECONTACT_STILL_POINT
keys.causal_role: separate roof placement from actual collision
keys.motion_arc_root_note: threat closes on an already-established hand endpoint; pelvis drops another cell

keys.name: OVERHEAD_CONTACT_LOCK
keys.causal_role: make contact a fixed constraint while the body begins to shear beneath it
keys.motion_arc_root_note: right hand remains fixed at the contact point while head/pelvis travel down-left

keys.name: ROOF_SHEAR_CRUSH
keys.causal_role: convert denied overhead displacement into torso shear and old-lead support peel
keys.motion_arc_root_note: contact hand stays fixed; pelvis slides down-left; left foot leaves support before recovery begins

keys.name: SCISSOR_OPEN_UNDER_LOAD
keys.causal_role: open the free leg into a distinct scissor while the roof still owns the incoming line
keys.motion_arc_root_note: single right-foot support; free left leg sweeps high/left while pelvis keeps paying shear debt

keys.name: ROOF_PEEL_AFTER_SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.causal_role: release the external line without letting the body spring back; guard peels late
keys.motion_arc_root_note: contact is gone but root remains low/left; right hand drops on a lagging arc

keys.name: SCISSOR_PREPLANT
keys.causal_role: author the new-foot approach before it becomes support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left foot reaches below and outside the pelvis but remains explicitly unsupported

keys.name: NEW_FOOT_SCISSOR_CATCH
keys.causal_role: let the new foot own the root in deep compression while the old support lifts
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left catch happens before height recovery; old right foot is now free and trails high

keys.name: COUNTER_TORQUE_OVERTRAVEL
keys.causal_role: overshoot past the new plant with head/guard and free leg on different lag arcs
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new left foot stays pinned; pelvis countertravels right while guard remains late/high

keys.name: SECOND_FOOT_REACQUIRE_LATE_GUARD
keys.causal_role: reacquire the second foot before reopening task authority
keys.motion_arc_root_note: base restacks at a new address while right arm still trails the body

keys.name: DISPLACED_READY_DEBT
keys.causal_role: end guarded and usable but visibly displaced, with asymmetry and debt preserved
keys.motion_arc_root_note: ready returns compressed and two cells left of the opening pelvis; guard remains asymmetric and lower, preserving recovery debt
